mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM public.auth_credential WHERE subject_type = 'PLATFORM_IDENTITY' AND is_deleted = false

SELECT id, subject_type, subject_id, password_hash, algorithm, password_changed_at, credential_version, status, version FROM public.auth_credential WHERE subject_type = #{subjectType} AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND is_deleted = false LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.auth_credential ( subject_type, subject_id, password_hash, algorithm, password_changed_at, credential_version, status, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{subjectType}, #{subjectId}, #{passwordHash}, #{algorithm}, #{passwordChangedAt}, #{credentialVersion}, #{status}, #{subjectId}, #{subjectId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE public.auth_credential SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, algorithm = 'ARGON2ID_V1', password_changed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, credential_version = credential_version + 1, status = 'ACTIVE', updated_by = #{accountId}, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE subject_type = 'TENANT_ACCOUNT' AND subject_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND password_hash IS NULL AND is_deleted = false

UPDATE public.auth_credential SET status = 'RESET_REQUIRED', credential_version = credential_version + 1, updated_by = #{accountId}, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE subject_type = 'TENANT_ACCOUNT' AND subject_id = #{accountId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'RESET_REQUIRED') AND password_hash IS NOT NULL AND is_deleted = false

UPDATE public.auth_credential SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, algorithm = 'ARGON2ID_V1', password_changed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, credential_version = credential_version + 1, status = 'ACTIVE', updated_by = #{accountId}, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE subject_type = 'TENANT_ACCOUNT' AND subject_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'RESET_REQUIRED' AND password_hash IS NOT NULL AND is_deleted = false
